datasets.title: Myanmar Buildings (Overture Maps Export)
datasets.description: The Overture Maps buildings dataset describes human-made structures with roofs or interior spaces that are permanently or semi-permanently in one place. Resources split by administrative level 1 .. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/myanmar-buildings-overture-maps-export]

lineage.description: Building footprints and structural attributes were compiled by Overture Maps Foundation from multiple open-source geospatial datasets (OpenStreetMap, Esri, Microsoft, Google) and organized by Myanmar administrative level 1 divisions. The dataset provides geometric and semantic building characteristics for exposure assessment in disaster risk contexts.

sources.name: Overture Maps Foundation
sources.description: Aggregated building footprints and attributes from OpenStreetMap, Esri Community Maps, Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints, and Google Open Buildings
